verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Docusaurus's document *versioning* feature (docs-6, docs-19, docs-23) which lets users version their content, but this is unrelated to a documented deprecation policy for the product's own APIs (plugin API, theme API, config schema) that an AI-native consumer could rely on. No citation mentions semver guarantees, API changelogs, or a deprecation policy for Docusaurus's own interfaces.
